note: Thinking and sampling are usually set per request (for example chat_template_kwargs and temperature), not in the recipe.

cases.setup:
vonkctl key create NAME --output CLIENT_KEY_FILE
export OPENAI_API_KEY="$(cat CLIENT_KEY_FILE)"
export OPENAI_BASE_URL='https://vonk-forge.example.ts.net/v1'
cases.python:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen-code",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
